title: A pull request shows what a stack change would do
description:
```gherkin
Feature: Infrastructure changes are checked before merge

  Scenario: Templates are linted and the config is validated without AWS
    Given a pull request that changes anything under infra/
    When CI runs
    Then cfn-lint and the stack config checks run with no AWS access
    And the required check "ci" fails if either fails

  Scenario: The pull request shows the live difference with a read-only role
    Given a pull request from a branch in this repository
    When the plan job runs as the read-only plan role
    Then the job summary shows, per stack, whether it would be created, imported, updated or unchanged
    And the plan role cannot create, change or delete anything

  Scenario: A fork gets no AWS access
    Given a pull request from a fork
    When CI runs
    Then the lint job runs and the plan job is skipped
```
